description: Structural requirements for all compiled database migrations

rules.description: Migration files must be named: {version}_{snake_case_name}.up.sql and {version}_{snake_case_name}.down.sql
Every CREATE TABLE must include created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() and updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
rules.check: presence of created_at and updated_at with NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()

rules.description: If spec.softDelete is true, table must include deleted_at TIMESTAMP NULL
Primary key must be named 'id' and use UUID or BIGSERIAL — never INT without explicit justification
rules.check: id UUID PRIMARY KEY or id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY

rules.description: All column names must be snake_case — never camelCase in SQL
Foreign key constraints must be named: fk_{table}_{referenced_table} (e.g. fk_orders_users)
Migration files must not contain SELECT statements — migrations only change structure, not query data
rules.check: absence of SELECT in up.sql (except in DO $$ blocks for conditional logic)
